reconstruction.source: AU1 first-return natural results plus the four existing opposite-route progress_first/use_owned paired results; BB1 read-only predictions checked against actual restored return offers.
reconstruction.selection: All four offset0/8 × firstA/B histories, followed by the opposite A/B route with the existing progress_first/use_owned preparation. Exactly eight existing prefix expeditions reconstructed and eight new C comparison branches; retain both predicted purchase-skip entries.
reconstruction.checkpoint_boundary: After the second return settlement and actual AT offer generation, before new preparation, purchase or surplus conversion. First return preserves AU purchase/home/surplus steps.
reconstruction.C_status: All four checkpoints must have zero previous C departures and no C clear.
reconstruction.equality_scope: Compare all available AU preparation, terminal, receipt, boundary and action-derived aggregate fields. AU paired results do not retain a full action list or saved-state hash; do not claim those historical identities. Save new prefix decisions and hashes; first-return hash may additionally match the existing BA prefix hash.

comparison.preparation: Unchanged AR C adapt learning/equipment and AU use_owned card preparation.
comparison.learning_first: Perform existing AR/AU preparation, then consider a candidate using remaining unspent funds only. Re-prepare only after an actual purchase.
comparison.refund_acquisition_first: On a copy, cancel only enough whole learned bases to afford a candidate, then purchase and prepare. If any candidate enters the resulting legal preparation, perform that explicit Q.learn cancellation on the real branch, purchase through existing Session.buy, and prepare. If no candidate is selected, perform neither refund nor purchase; verify unchanged save before normal preparation.
comparison.refund_rule: Reverse the existing AR learning priority, stopping when affordable; these four checkpoints have only PS02 paid at 2pt. Refund PS02 explicitly for 200 units only when a candidate would enter actual preparation. Purchase400 then leaves100 units and no learned base. No candidate means no refund or purchase, then ordinary preparation.
comparison.candidate_order: Unchanged BA candidate-copy evaluation: refund if policy allows, purchase, AR C adapt and AU use_owned; retain only actual selected candidates; cards first, passives use existing C home_value+affix_value divided by cost, candidate ID last. Use actual AT batch; no combat lookahead.
comparison.seed: Each pair shares the native third-expedition seed: 2, 2, 10, 10. Confirm from nextRun=2 and the unchanged rotated C.seeds sequence before departure.
comparison.terminal: Run only until existing clear/defeat/cutoff; never extend the existing160-player-action cap. Report cutoffs distinctly.

record: Actual unspent funds, historical learning payments, full refundable learning amount, required shortage, explicit removed bases and refund units, retained learning payment, newly learned/relearned payment, purchase spending, remaining balance
Each candidate: affordable now, affordable after explicit refund, learned-base eligibility and actual legal-preparation selection; skipped reason

Old inventory and bought item separately: owned, eligible/available, selected, player use before/after refill, NPC/field-material use; passive ID trace unavailability and limited receipt-based derivation
Clear/defeat, actions, time, HP, receipts, decisions and checkpoint/input hashes

Available AU prefix preparation/terminal/receipt/boundary/action-aggregate equality; first-return BA hash; actual AT candidates versus BB pure-generation estimate; prefix action predictions; newly fixed checkpoint hashes. BA-style refund/purchase/save replay, unchanged checkpoint/old possessions, and all eight new C action predictions.
limits: No implicit refund added to purchase API; only existing public Q.learn and Session.buy operations. No sale or offer reroll in comparison branches.
Minimum refund heuristic holds only for these equal 2pt bases; do not generalize to heterogeneous historical fees or claim optimality.
No exhaustive candidate/deck optimization, new seed search, price/capacity changes, human enjoyment claim, UI or runtime changes.
Basic design 0.53 and D53 remain unchanged.

All eight new C branches are first C departures from the fixed second-return states. Comparing policies within the same second return holds the added A/B cost equal; this does not prove the extra A/B expedition is efficient or needed.
The two no-choice histories remain in the comparison; no extra seeds, candidate search, alternate prefix or post-result retuning.
